question: How is PCA different from supervised feature selection?
direct_answer: PCA ignores labels and preserves input variance, while supervised feature selection tries to improve prediction of a target.
expanded_answer: PCA is unsupervised: it looks only at the input geometry. Supervised methods use label information to choose or transform features that help prediction, which can be very different from the directions of highest variance.
common_wrong_ideas: High variance always means high predictive power
